title: Positive Randomized Probability Has a Witness
statement: Let $m$ be a natural number and let $A$ be a decidable property of Boolean lists. If the fraction of length-$m$ Boolean words $w$ for which $A(w)$ holds is positive, then some function $r : 	ext{Fin}(m) \to \{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ has $A$ on its associated length-$m$ list.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a decidable property of Boolean lists
The randomized probability of $A$ at length $m$ is positive
